email.title: SUPLA Email
email.description: Email used to log in to SUPLA mobile app/cloud.

password.title: SUPLA Password
password.description: Password used to log in to SUPLA mobile app/cloud.

server.title: Server Override
server.description: Optional SUPLA cloud server hostname or URL. If omitted, autodiscover is used.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Select SUPLA native realtime protocol (recommended) or REST fallback.

nativeHelperPath.title: Native Helper Path
nativeHelperPath.description: Optional absolute path to supla-native-bridge helper binary.

nativeSsl.title: Native SSL
nativeSsl.description: Override native protocol SSL setting. If omitted, derived from server URL.

nativePort.title: Native Port
nativePort.description: Override SUPLA native protocol port (default 2016 SSL / 2015 TCP).

nativeConnectTimeoutMs.title: Native Connect Timeout (ms)
nativeConnectTimeoutMs.description: Connection timeout for native SUPLA protocol.

nativeReconnectDelayMs.title: Native Reconnect Delay (ms)
nativeReconnectDelayMs.description: Reconnect delay used by native SUPLA helper.

nativeActionTimeoutMs.title: Native Action Timeout (ms)
nativeActionTimeoutMs.description: Timeout waiting for action acknowledgement from native SUPLA helper.

nativeClientName.title: Native Client Name
nativeClientName.description: Optional SUPLA client name override sent during native registration.

nativeClientSoftVersion.title: Native Client Version
nativeClientSoftVersion.description: Optional SUPLA client software version override sent during native registration.

nativeGuid.title: Native GUID (hex)
nativeGuid.description: Optional fixed SUPLA client GUID in hex. If omitted, plugin stores a persistent generated GUID.

nativeAuthKey.title: Native Auth Key (hex)
nativeAuthKey.description: Optional fixed SUPLA client AuthKey in hex. If omitted, plugin stores a persistent generated key.

apiPrefix.title: API Prefix Override
apiPrefix.description: REST transport only: optional API prefix override (for example /api/3).

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (s)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: REST transport only: how often channel states are refreshed from SUPLA cloud.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: REST transport: HTTP timeout. Native transport: fallback timeout for helper operations.

includeHidden.title: Include Hidden Channels
includeHidden.description: Expose channels that are hidden in SUPLA cloud.
